email_subject: Application - Founding Creator & Social Media Associate at LINEAL
email_body:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate position, as advertised. My background as a Junior Digital Marketer, with a strong foundation in content management, social media integration, and performance analytics, aligns with your needs for owning and growing social channels.

While my direct experience lies more in text-based content and web development, I am incredibly passionate about digital storytelling and eager to translate my "creator mindset," honed through independent projects like mirook.com, into dynamic video formats. I am proficient in leveraging analytics to understand audience engagement and quick to adopt new tools required to produce impactful content.

Based next to Antwerp, I am perfectly positioned to be on-site for LINEAL events. I am excited by your vision for 1v1 basketball and believe my dedication and adaptability would be a significant asset to your fast-moving startup.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to LINEAL’s journey.

cover_letter:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate position at LINEAL. The opportunity to contribute to Europe’s first structured 1v1 basketball championship and to shape its digital narrative from the ground up deeply resonates with my passion for dynamic content and community building. My background as a Junior Digital Marketer has equipped me with a robust understanding of content strategy, audience engagement, and the technical underpinnings of digital visibility.

Throughout my experience at Episto, I’ve honed skills in crafting engaging, keyword-targeted content and managing website presence, ensuring that stories and information reach their intended audiences effectively. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates a full-cycle approach to digital presence, from site design and structured data implementation to social media integration on platforms like Instagram and Facebook. This work required a keen eye for detail, an understanding of online visibility (GEO/AEO), and the ability to measure performance, all crucial for growing social media channels and creating content that captures attention. I am adept at leveraging analytics tools to inform content decisions and optimize reach.

While my direct professional experience has focused on web content and SEO, the core of my work has always been about crafting compelling narratives and ensuring they are discovered. I am eager to apply this "creator mindset" and my technical foundation to the exciting challenge of video production, from filming and editing trailers to developing recurring story formats for LINEAL events. Your "JFDI" philosophy strongly aligns with my proactive approach to learning and building, making me confident in my ability to quickly master new tools and techniques required to own the content journey from idea to upload. As a resident near Antwerp, I am perfectly positioned to be present courtside and backstage at LINEAL’s events.

I am enthusiastic about contributing my energy and adaptable skill set to LINEAL’s mission. I am confident that my dedication to impactful digital presence, combined with a genuine passion for the dynamic world of sports and startups, makes me a strong candidate for this unique role. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how I can help LINEAL tell its story.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
